units.source_text: "我觉得你最好还是不要多来这种地方啊。"

en.t: "I think it would be better if you did not come to places like this too often."

units.source_text: "我认为你是老实人，不要在这种地方陷得太深，

en.t: "I think you are an honest person, so do not get too deeply involved in places like this,

units.source_text: 还是老老实实地将精力放在生意上好啊。

en.t: and it would be better for you to put your energy honestly into your business.

units.source_text: 虽然我很愿意你常来，但我相信你会明白我讲这番话的心意，

en.t: Although I would be very happy for you to come often, I believe you will understand the feeling behind what I am saying,

units.source_text: 因为我把你当做弟弟来看待的啊！"

en.t: because I think of you and treat you like a younger brother!"
